newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Enterindo Wahanatama bond issue oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Enterindo Wahanatama bond issue oversubscribed.

text.p: Indonesian private chemical producer PT Eterindo Wahanatama announced on Monday the private placement of a $65 million mandatory convertible bonds issue ahead of its float on the Jakarta stock exchange later this year.
The company said in a statement the bond issue was heavily oversubscribed.
"Demand was strong enough to have provided us with almost $90 million," Eterindo's president director Hadiran Sridjaja said.

The statement said the bond issue, whose lead underwriter was Vickers Ballas Tamara, will be convertible into new shares of the issuer on the date of the company's listing, expected to take place in the first half of 1997.
"If the deal is an indication of market sentiment, the firm's plan to offer equity in the first half of this year looks very favourable," it said.

Vickers's director of investment banking Tariq Khan said in the same statement the issue would finance the expansion of Eterindo's chemical manufacturing facilities and provide the firm with the working capital to boost its market share.

Eterindo is a producer of synthetic resins and plasticizers used in a wide variety of industrial and everyday consumer products such as construction materials, packaging, textiles, paints, automotive parts, footwear, carpets and buttons.
